BiblicalUsage: Calcol is an Israelite remembered for wisdom — named with Ethan and Heman and Darda as the men Solomon's wisdom surpassed, and listed among the sons of Zerah in the genealogy of Judah. His name survives because Solomon surpassed him, and that is how the wise are remembered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Calcol shows that wisdom has a history: Solomon was wiser than the wise men before him, and the wisdom of God in Christ surpasses them all.
